key_findings: Olcegepant given 24 h after CSD in mice prevented light-zone hypomotility, improved light tolerability and raised facial heat pain threshold at 72 h.
CGRP pathway may lower facial heat pain threshold even without overt trigeminal sensitization, supporting pre-emptive anti-CGRP therapy.
